topics: Speech Production :- Acoustic theory of speech production
Spectrogram- Wide and narrow band spectrogram
Time domain parameters (Short time energy, short time zero crossing Rate, ACF)
Frequency domain parameters - Filter bank analysis
Cepstral analysis - Pitch and Formant estimation using cepstral analysis
Auto correlation method - Levinson Durbin Algorithm
Speech Enhancement :-   Spectral subtraction and Filtering
class of coders : Time domain/spectral domain/vocoders
Speaker Recognition :- Speaker verification and speaker identification
Language identification - Implicit and explicit models
Machine learning models in Speaker Recognition
Signal Processing models of audio perception - Basic anatomy of hearing System

partA.description:
● 2 Questions from each module.

partB.description:
● Each question carries 9 marks.  
● Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.  
● Each question can have a maximum of 3 subdivisions.

courseOutcomes.description: To recall various steps in the speech production process
To summarise various speech processing approaches
To develop speech-processing applications in various domains
To analyse the speech processing model for audio perception
